children: Bitcoin ETFs are showing net inflows for six consecutive days totaling over $2.8 billion, according to data from Coinglass, however the inflows have slowed over the past three sessions the crypto analytics provider says. The trend leaves the cryptocurrency "exposed to downside risk if the macro backdrop deteriorates," says Joseph Dahrieh of Tickmill in a note. Bitcoin is down 0.4% to $83,977. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
